title: Concept: Yarn allowed to rewrite the lockfile during CI
description: .yarnrc.yml declares a Yarn setting that lets an install update the lockfile it was given, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A CI run can resolve versions the review never saw and report success, so the committed lockfile stops describing what was built.
risk: A CI run can resolve versions the review never saw and report success, so the committed lockfile stops describing what was built.
